challenges.content: Give your best impression of someone in the group and let everyone guess who it is.
Describe your dream day using only five words.
Tell a short story about an ordinary moment as if it were an epic movie scene.
Let the group choose a harmless word you must naturally use in your next sentence.
Name three things you appreciate about the people here.
Recreate your reaction to the funniest surprise you have experienced.
Speak in a dramatic movie-trailer voice for the next 20 seconds.
Invent a team name and a one-line slogan for this group.
Share a tiny talent or skill you can demonstrate right now.
Tell everyone about a time you laughed at the worst possible moment.

events.title: EVERYONE ANSWERS
events.content: What's one small thing that can instantly make your day better?

events.title: PICK A PLAYER
events.content: Choose someone in the group. Tell them one thing you appreciate about them.

events.title: SURPRISE QUESTION
events.content: What is something you would love to experience at least once in your life?
